name: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: New Subcomponents:FRESH-IT (Farmer’s Research & Enterprise in Spice Holdings for Innovative Technology)
teName: సుగంధ ద్రవ్యాల ఎగుమతి ప్రచారం మరియు నాణ్యత మెరుగుదల కోసం సమగ్ర పథకం మరియు ఏలకుల పరిశోధన మరియు అభివృద్ధిః కొత్త ఉపభాగాలుః ఫ్రెష్-ఐటి (ఇన్నోవేటివ్ టెక్నాలజీ కోసం స్పైస్ హోల్డింగ్స్ లో ఫార్మర్స్ రీసెర్చ్ & ఎంటర్ప్రైజ్)
teBrief: సుగంధ ద్రవ్యాల ఉత్పత్తి, ఉత్పాదకత మరియు నాణ్యతను పెంచడానికి సుగంధ ద్రవ్యాల రైతులు వినూత్న సాంకేతిక పరిజ్ఞానాన్ని అవలంబించేలా ప్రోత్సహించడం మరియు మెరుగైన సుగంధ ద్రవ్యాల రకాలు మరియు తక్కువ ఖర్చుతో కూడిన పంటకోత యంత్రాలను అభివృద్ధి…
brief: To encourage spice farmers to adopt innovative technologies and develop improved spice varieties and cost-effective post-harvest machinery to enhance the production, productivity, and quality of spices.
briefFull: To encourage spice farmers to adopt innovative technologies and develop improved spice varieties and cost-effective post-harvest machinery to enhance the production, productivity, and quality of spices.
details:
The FRESH-IT (Farmer's Research & Enterprise in Spice Holdings for Innovative Technology) subcomponent is part of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom, implemented by the Spices Board under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India.
The scheme aims to motivate spice farmers to take up innovations and improvements on their farms to develop promising spice varieties and new post-harvest improvement machinery/equipment for the spice farming community of the country at an affordable cost, thereby increasing the production, productivity, and quality of spices.
The scheme is being implemented in accordance with the modalities and guidelines approved by the Competent Authority under the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom during the 15th Finance Commission period (2021–22 to 2025–26).
benefits: > Grant-in-aid subject to a maximum of ₹ 7, 50,000/- per innovation in two installments of ₹ 3, 75,000/- in two phases based on the progress / completion of the innovation as recommended by the technical committee constituted for the purpose of evaluating the innovation by the farmer in development of new clones/ cultivars/ variety and machines/ post-harvest improvement equipments developed for improving quality of spices.
eligibility:
1.All spice growing States and regions in India
2. Secretary Spices Board will constitute the Technical Committee with Director (Dev.) Spices Board as Chairperson of the Committee drawing members from ICRI, ICAR-IISR, identified SAUs of the State of reported innovation and concerned Regional Officer of Spices Board, on production aspects; and members of the Committee for evaluating innovations on post-harvest equipments will be the members of the already existing Regional Evaluation Committes constituted. Assistance will be extended based on MoU with Spices Board.
3. Concerned Officer of the Board who identified the innovation will forward the case to Director (Dev.) through proper channel for a preliminary scrutiny by a team of Officers nominated by Director (Dev.) and qualified cases will be presented to the technical committee for consideration and evaluation.
howToApply:
[Online]
**Registration**
Step 1: The applicant should visit the [ServicesPlus](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/) website.
Step 2: Click on the “[Register” ](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/citizenRegistration.html)option on the homepage.
Step 3: Fill out the registration form by entering Full Name, Email ID, Mobile Number, Password, selecting State, and Captcha.
Step 4: Review all details carefully and submit the registration form.
Step 5: An OTP will be sent to your registered mobile number or email; enter the OTP and click “Verify.”
Step 6: Registration will be completed successfully, and a confirmation message will be displayed or sent via email.
**Login**
Step 1: The applicant should visit the ServicesPlus website and click on [“Login.”](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/loginWindow.do)
Step 2: Enter your Email ID, Password, and Captcha.
Step 3: Select the relevant service/scheme name.
Step 4: Fill in the required details in the application form.
Step 5: Submit the application.
documentsRequired:
a) Aadhaar card
b) Bank details
c)MoU in prescribed form

te.howToApply:
[Online]
**నమోదు** దశ 1: దరఖాస్తుదారుడు [సర్వీసెస్ ప్లస్](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt) వెబ్సైట్ను సందర్శించాలి. దశ 2: హోమ్పేజీలోని "[రిజిస్టర్"](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/citizenRegistration.html) ఎంపికపై క్లిక్ చేయండి. దశ 3: పూర్తి పేరు, ఇమెయిల్ ఐడి, మొబైల్ నంబర్, పాస్వర్డ్, రాష్ట్రం మరియు క్యాప్చాను ఎంచుకోవడం ద్వారా రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ ఫారమ్ను పూరించండి. దశ 4: అన్ని వివరాలను జాగ్రత్తగా సమీక్షించి, రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ ఫారమ్ను సమర్పించండి. దశ 5: మీ రిజిస్టర్డ్ మొబైల్ నంబర్ లేదా ఇమెయిల్కు ఒక ఓటిపి పంపబడుతుంది; ఓటిపిని నమోదు చేసి, "ధృవీకరించండి" క్లిక్ చేయండి. దశ 6: రిజిస్ట్రేషన్ విజయవంతంగా పూర్తవుతుంది, మరియు నిర్ధారణ సందేశం ప్రదర్శించబడుతుంది లేదా ఇమెయిల్ ద్వారా పంపబడుతుంది. **లాగిన్** దశ 1: దరఖాస్తుదారు సర్వీసెస్ ప్లస్ వెబ్సైట్ను సందర్శించి, ["లాగిన్"](https://serviceonline.gov.in/dbt/loginWindow.do) పై క్లిక్ చేయాలి దశ 2: మీ ఇమెయిల్ ఐడి, పాస్వర్డ్ మరియు క్యాప్చాను నమోదు చేయండి. దశ 3: సంబంధిత సేవ/పథకం పేరును ఎంచుకోండి. దశ 4: దరఖాస్తు ఫారంలో అవసరమైన వివరాలను పూరించండి. దశ 5: దరఖాస్తును సమర్పించండి.

faqs.a: FRESH-IT is a subcomponent of the Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom that supports innovative ideas developed by spice farmers.

faqs.q: What is the objective of the scheme?
faqs.a: The scheme aims to encourage spice farmers to develop innovative spice varieties and affordable post-harvest machinery/equipment to improve the production, productivity, and quality of spices.
The scheme is implemented by the Spices Board, under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India.
faqs.qTe: ఏ సంస్థ ఈ పథకాన్ని అమలు చేస్తుంది?

faqs.q: Who can apply under the scheme?
faqs.a: Spice farmers from all spice-growing States and regions in India who have developed innovative spice varieties or post-harvest machinery/equipment can apply.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం కింద ఎవరు దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు?

faqs.a: Eligible applicants can receive grant-in-aid up to ₹7,50,000 per innovation.

faqs.q: How is the financial assistance released?
faqs.a: The grant is released in two installments of ₹3,75,000 each, based on the progress and completion of the innovation as recommended by the Technical Committee.

faqs.q: Is there any agreement to be signed before receiving assistance?
faqs.a: Yes. Assistance is provided based on a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) executed with the Spices Board.
faqs.qTe: సహాయం పొందే ముందు ఏదైనా ఒప్పందంపై సంతకం చేయాలా?

faqs.a: The innovation is evaluated by a Technical Committee constituted by the Secretary, Spices Board.

The concerned officer who identifies the innovation forwards the proposal to the Director (Development). After preliminary scrutiny, eligible proposals are presented before the Technical Committee for evaluation.

faqs.q: Is the scheme available across India?
faqs.a: Yes. The scheme is available in all spice-growing States and regions of India.
faqs.qTe: ఈ పథకం భారతదేశం అంతటా అందుబాటులో ఉందా?
